name: verification-admission-repair
goal: Declared headless scenario commands admit one registered test and record actual assertions; profiler bootstrap and Mac probe fixtures remain bounded.

evidence: Prior Codex module-tasks scenario declared multiple files for a one-file wrapper and omitted registered scopes. The existing design-option capture also deadlocked in profiler schema bootstrap; fresh-script admission prevented a Mac fixture from starting inside its unchanged 500ms limit.

Custom loop commands had been trusted without executing declared scenario targets. Normal self-verify-config now validates every headless wrapper signature, package and registered states; cold runner coverage imports the real transitive schema graph.
Immutable profiler red checkpoint d481a078e26d9d0a18ea5672c5c691422d23780929f0025484972aa8cad094ef reproduces the registry bootstrap self-wait on the frozen test corpus.
Use one registered file per capture and validate headless declarations in normal checks. Load schema bootstrap before the lazy loader and launch Mac probe scripts through the installed interpreter.
